$comment: Baseline for scripts/check-styles.mjs (ADR-0006 §6). appCssCeiling: App.css's non-blank, non-comment line count — lower it in the same change that shrinks App.css; null once App.css is deleted. migrated: files whose surface has migrated (they may reference no App.css class) — append, never remove. rawColourExempt: files excused from the raw-colour rule, each with its reason.

rawColourExempt.reason: Dormant by design (AGENTS.md; imported by nothing). Its palette utilities generate no CSS since theme.css removes the palette. Disposition: ticket 25.
